records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Mia,

Looking to get more out of Wrenfield? Inviting your teammates is the single biggest thing that makes it click.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Ridge Group set up
records.body:
Hi Mia,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to two outreach emails (email:8ddb8882, email:73dc2e6d) or tickets. No engagement signal at all on a Starter plan, so unaided activation in the remaining 8 days looks unlikely.

draft.subject: A quick hand getting Ridge Group's first project up
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Checking in after your Wrenfield signup. If it's been a busy week, no problem at all -- most teams start by creating a project, since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time whenever you're ready.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
